branches.question: Can an accessible public source establish the specific storage-tank compliance order and whether its conditions were satisfied?
branches.ordinary_explanation: A technical compliance correction could be routine and unrelated to any environmental damage or facility closure.
branches.target: 2025 order, inspection and corrective-action completion evidence
branches.stop: Stop after one bilingual exact search and existing government source if order remains unavailable; human obtains A-2025-02587 and order.

branches.question: Does the May 2026 closure announcement identify the tank order as a reason for withdrawal?
branches.ordinary_explanation: Operational range, seasonal access and repair economics explain the decision independently.
branches.target: Official closure announcement and contemporaneous coverage
branches.stop: Reject any causal claim unless a primary source explicitly connects the order and decision.

branches.question: Does public policy describe authority and consent/retention controls specifically for Canadian personnel in training?
branches.ordinary_explanation: Consenting staff may volunteer as training subjects under a bounded authorized programme.
branches.target: Public privacy assessment, intelligence directives and exact training authority
branches.stop: Stop at public policy boundary if the 2025 CONOP is not publicly downloadable; hand off the 95-page release.

branches.question: Can public material verify completion of the privacy assessment mitigation actions by the 2025 training period?
branches.ordinary_explanation: Actions may be completed internally without public reporting.
branches.stop: Do not infer noncompliance from absence; identify exact missing completion records.

branches.question: Does the publicly linked PDF actually correspond to A-2025-01384 and substantiate the already-published policy description?
branches.ordinary_explanation: The summary points to ordinary provincial-law-based safeguards rather than an undisclosed blanket detention power.
branches.target: Linked seven-page military police policy and provenance
branches.stop: If obtainable, inspect headings/dates/consent and detention constraints; classify as covered if matched, without making independent legal conclusions.
